text:
sophia: Quick sync request with OrionCompute to run a joint perf/W sweep next week. Goal: characterize throughput vs power cap across kernels and tuning knobs. Need telemetry spec + A/V for marketing announcement. 

ajay: SG. Proposed matrix: seq_len 512/1024, batch 1/4, power caps 200W/250W/300W, workload: gpt2-medium gen @ 256 tokens + resnet50 infer. 

orion-liaison: Orion here — we can expose PMBus + per-socket power via iDRAC and provide SOC perf counters. We'll also bring a pre-release kernel with tiled-attention patches. Do you have acceptance criteria? 

mike: Acceptance: 95th perc latency under 200ms for batch1 at target throughput and power/W delta <= 15% vs baseline. We'll run Redwood runtime with these flags. 

mike: Config snippet:
```
./run_bench --model=gpt2-medium --seq=512 --batch=1 --quant=bf16 \n  --kernels=fused_attn,tiled_attn --power-cap=250 
```

sally-marketing: @sophia FYI marketing needs partner quote and logo clearance 48h before publish; legal needs embargo dates. We should target a soft publish on Tue if bench completes Friday. :calendar:

sophia: Noted. Legal roll: @legal-bot can you confirm NDA status with Orion? Also need list of people to cc on telemetry access. 

legal-bot: NDA finalized 2026-03-15. Orion has signed the addendum for data sharing. No open items. 

orion-liaison: Team list: me (liaison), press@orioncompute, bench-eng: rita, sysops: tanaka. We'll share a docker image with perf tools. 

bench-bot: FYI scheduled bench run: start 1767782400 (UTC) — automating collection to S3://redwood-partner-bench/orion/1767778888 . 

ajay: I'll own kernel patch application and early smoke. mike, can you hook the runtime to read PMBus telemetry path /sys/class/powercap/* ? 

mike: Yes. We'll add a small agent to correlate token timestamps with power samples. Plan: 1) dry run Wed, 2) full sweep Fri, 3) debrief Mon. 

sophia: Great. Action items: ajay apply kernel -> Wed EOD, orion provide docker + counters -> Thur EOD, mike integrate telemetry parser -> Thu EOD, sally draft joint announcement -> Fri AM. 

orion-liaison: Sounds good. We'll sync Thursday 10:00 PT to validate images. 

sophia: Meeting invite sent. Thanks all :rocket:
